fn: async () => { /* S0 baseline: nothing landed, no overlay open */ const t = window.__test; const s = t.getState(); return !s.activeMinigame && s.globals.phish_chris_landed === false && (s.globals.phish_chris_attempts || 0) === 0; }

async () => { /* A1 the mail client opened on the Operator mailbox */ const mg = window.MinigameFramework.currentMinigame; const s = mg.getTestState(); return s.overlay.sceneType === 'mail-client' && s.mail.account.id === 'guest'; }

async () => { /* A2 Compose shows the free-text box (bodyMode freeText wired through the shell) */ const mg = window.MinigameFramework.currentMinigame; mg.openCompose(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 120)); const c = mg.composer.getState(); const area = mg.composer.root.querySelector('textarea.mail-compose-freetext'); return c.freeTextEnabled === true && !!area && c.contactId === 'chris' && c.targetId === 'chris'; }

async () => { /* A3 type flavour into the box, choose the applicant pretext, attach the CV; the message carries freeText and Send is enabled */ const mg = window.MinigameFramework.currentMinigame; const area = mg.composer.root.querySelector('textarea.mail-compose-freetext'); area.value = 'PS: thanks for keeping the careers inbox open.'; area.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); mg.composer.chooseTemplate('pretext', 'pretext_apply'); mg.composer.setAttachment('kit_cv'); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 120)); const c = mg.composer.getState(); const m = mg.composer.buildMessage(); return c.freeText === 'PS: thanks for keeping the careers inbox open.' && m.freeText === 'PS: thanks for keeping the careers inbox open.' && c.sendEnabled === true; }

async () => { /* A4 send it */ const mg = window.MinigameFramework.currentMinigame; mg.composer.root.querySelector('button.mail-compose-send').click(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200)); return true; }

async () => { /* A5 the sent record carries the free text after the templated body, and judged as landed (the templated parts decided it) */ const ms = window.mailState; const sent = (ms.mailboxes.guest.messages || []).filter(m => m.folder === 'sent'); if (sent.length !== 1) return false; const r = sent[0]; return r.landed === true && /Could you review my CV when you have a moment\?/.test(r.body) && /PS: thanks for keeping the careers inbox open\.$/.test(r.body) && r.body.indexOf('PS:') > r.body.indexOf('Could you review'); }

async () => { /* A6 the data-only reply landed and set the outcome global; the free text never reached any global */ const t = window.__test; const g = t.getState().globals; const stray = Object.entries(g).some(([k, v]) => typeof v === 'string' && v.includes('careers inbox open')); return g.phish_chris_landed === true && !stray; }
async () => { /* A7 the task completed */ const t = window.__test; const b = t.brief ? t.brief() : null; const g = t.getState().globals; return g.phish_chris_landed === true; }
